description: This PHP source file defines the OpenIdProvider entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map class properties to database table columns, representing OAuth OpenID providers with attributes such as id, provider name, URL, and status.

classes.name: OpenIdProvider
classes.description: Entity class representing an OpenID provider configuration in the database for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: setProviderName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: getProviderUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the OpenID provider.

methods.name: setProviderUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for the OpenID provider.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status indicating whether the provider is active.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the provider.
